title: glue2
description: A station at a fixed position on the shopfloor that realises one service. Each of its Actions runs one recipe: it produces the recipe's output product at the station's own position and consumes the recipe's inputs, whose state becomes 'consumed' and whose position becomes null. An Action has no effect unless every input product of that recipe already lies at the station. The Actions themselves differ per station and are given in the instance Thing Descriptions.

produceCaseWithBattery.title: produce caseWithBattery
produceCaseWithBattery.description: Run the caseWithBattery recipe: consume battery, caseWithSensorModule and place caseWithBattery at this station. Has no effect unless every input already lies at the station.

produceDisplayUnit.title: produce displayUnit
produceDisplayUnit.description: Run the displayUnit recipe: consume glass, lcd and place displayUnit at this station. Has no effect unless every input already lies at the station.

produceSmartphone.title: produce smartphone
produceSmartphone.description: Run the smartphone recipe: consume caseWithBattery, displayUnit and place smartphone at this station. Has no effect unless every input already lies at the station.
